arguments.title: Parcel Returns Desk: brief to structured requirements
arguments.spec:
# Requirements extraction: Parcel Returns Desk brief

11 live obligations (OB-01..OB-08, OB-10..OB-12) must each become exactly one structured requirement
{id, actor, trigger, outcome, acceptance} in spec/requirements.json. OB-09 is WITHDRAWN and must never
become a requirement. actor must be one of the brief's 5 closed-glossary actors (Shopper, Returns Agent,
Carrier, Finance System, Auditor), spelled exactly as the glossary spells it. trigger/outcome/acceptance
have minimum lengths (12/12/20 chars) and, together with actor, the four fields must all differ from one
another. acceptance may not be a verbatim slice of the obligation's own sentence -- it must name the
observation, boundary or timing that would expose a violation. Set complete:true only once every live
obligation is covered exactly once -- that is reserved for the last card. input/**, test/** and
scripts/run-tests.mjs are frozen evidence (content-digest checked by npm test) and must never be edited.
The sandbox is offline: never add a dependency.
arguments.plan:
Decompose by actor (the brief's own suggested split), one record card per actor grouping its
obligations, chained SEQUENTIALLY through the single shared deliverable spec/requirements.json to avoid a
parallel-write race on one JSON file -- proven across three prior projects in this factory. A sixth card
reserved for the completeness pass re-derives all 11 live obligations independently and flips complete to
true only once every one of them is covered exactly once.

1. record-shopper-requirements: OB-01, OB-05, OB-11 (3 obligations)
2. record-returns-agent-requirements: OB-02, OB-06 (2 obligations) -- depends on 1
3. record-carrier-requirements: OB-03, OB-08 (2 obligations) -- depends on 2
4. record-finance-system-requirements: OB-04, OB-10 (2 obligations) -- depends on 3
5. record-auditor-requirements: OB-07, OB-12 (2 obligations) -- depends on 4
6. finalize-completeness: independent re-derivation + complete:true -- depends on 5
arguments.summary:
Turns the Parcel Returns Desk brief's 12 numbered obligations (11 live, 1 withdrawn) into 11
structured requirements in spec/requirements.json, one per obligation, split into 5 actor-grouped record
cards plus a final completeness pass. No implementation, no design, no estimation -- purely a spec
extraction job against a frozen, self-deriving verifier. No open assumptions: the brief and specification.md
are unambiguous about scope, shape and the actor glossary.
